provenance: Owned synthetic DiagramML data and layouts. Expected leaf bounds/font sizes were read independently from native reference regenerated drawings on 2026-10-11; local PDFs were visually inspected. Geometry-only reference controls cover both axes, absent/explicit coordinates, explicit dimensions and upper/lower aspect inequalities. Chromium production glyph measurements replay content predicates; they do not supply expected geometry. The no-aspect overflowing-body control retains native exhausted geometry and reports content failure. No reference-application diagrams, style definitions or font files are included.
